exercises.title: U1 听力·对话 Talking About the First Day
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Tom: Hi, Anna! How was your first day at senior high?
Anna: It was great, but I felt a bit nervous in the morning.
Tom: Me too. I got lost trying to find the science lab.
Anna: Did you join any clubs yet?
Tom: Yes, I joined the badminton club. We meet in the gym on Tuesdays.
Anna: That sounds fun. I chose the drama club because I love acting.
Tom: Nice! Standing on the stage must be exciting.
Anna: It is. I hope this year will be a wonderful new start.
exercises.translation_cn: 汤姆问安娜高中第一天怎么样;安娜说很棒,但早上有点紧张;汤姆也是,还找科学实验室时迷了路;安娜问汤姆加了社团没;汤姆加了羽毛球社,周二在体育馆活动;安娜选了戏剧社,因为爱表演;汤姆说登台一定很激动;安娜希望这一年是美好的新开始。

exercises.title: U1 听力·短文 Orientation Day
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Many schools hold an Orientation Day for new students.
It is a great chance to get to know the school and meet others.
On that day, you can walk around the campus and find your classrooms.
Teachers introduce the clubs and after-school activities you can join.
If you keep an open mind, you may even make some new friends.
exercises.translation_cn: 许多学校为新生举办迎新日;这是了解学校、结识他人的好机会;那天你可以在校园里走走,找到自己的教室;老师们会介绍可以参加的社团和课后活动;只要保持开放的心态,你甚至能交到新朋友。

questions.stem: Who is the Orientation Day for?
What can students do on that day?
options: Walk around the campus and find their classrooms.

questions.stem: What do teachers introduce?
What is one chance the day offers?
options: A chance to get to know the school.

questions.stem: How might you make new friends, according to the talk?

exercises.title: U1 听力·对话 Making a Weekend Study Plan
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Lily: Ben, shall we make a study plan for the weekend?
Ben: Good idea. There is so much to do that I feel under pressure.
Lily: First, let's list the things we are going to do.
Ben: Okay. We need to read English, finish maths and practise for the debate.
Lily: Right. Now let's decide how long each task will take.
Ben: We should do the most important one first, I think.
Lily: Agreed. And let's do only one task at a time.
Ben: Great. With a clear plan, the weekend feels much easier.
exercises.translation_cn: 莉莉提议为周末做学习计划;本说事情太多,感到压力;莉莉建议先列出要做的事;本说要读英语、做数学、准备辩论;莉莉建议再决定每项花多久;本认为应先做最重要的;莉莉同意,并建议一次只做一件事;本说有了清晰的计划,周末轻松多了。

questions.stem: What do Lily and Ben want to make?
Why does Ben feel under pressure?
options: There is so much to do.

questions.stem: What do they decide to do after listing the tasks?
options: Decide how long each task will take.

questions.stem: Which task does Ben think they should do first?
How does Ben feel about the weekend with a clear plan?

exercises.title: U1 听力·短文 A Tip for Taking Notes
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: In senior high, teachers often speak quickly during lessons.
At first, you may struggle to write down every word.
But thinking is more important than copying everything.
Try to note only the key information, such as names and numbers.
This simple habit will help you understand and remember more.
exercises.translation_cn: 在高中,老师讲课往往很快;起初,你可能很难记下每个词;但思考比把每句话都抄下来更重要;试着只记关键信息,比如名字和数字;这个简单的习惯会帮你理解并记住更多内容。

questions.stem: What do teachers often do during lessons?
What may be difficult at first?
What is more important than copying everything?
What kind of information should you note?
options: Key information like names and numbers.

questions.stem: What will this habit help you do?

exercises.title: U1 听力·对话 Asking a Senior for Advice
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Kate: Excuse me, you are a senior student, right? Can I ask for some advice?
Mark: Of course. What would you like to know?
Kate: How can I deal with all these new challenges?
Mark: Keep calm and be prepared. Plan your time every week.
Kate: What if I fail a test at the start?
Mark: Don't worry. If you fail, next time you can do better.
Kate: That's really helpful. Thank you so much.
Mark: My pleasure. Just keep an open mind and enjoy your new start.
exercises.translation_cn: 凯特向一位学长马克请教建议;马克乐意帮忙;凯特问如何应对新挑战;马克建议保持镇定、做好准备、每周规划时间;凯特担心一开始考试失败;马克说别担心,失败了下次能做得更好;凯特很感激;马克叫她保持开放心态,享受新开始。

questions.stem: Who does Kate ask for advice?
What does Kate want to know?
options: How to deal with new challenges.

questions.stem: What is Mark's first piece of advice?

options: Next time you can do better.

questions.stem: What does Mark tell Kate to do at the end?
options: Keep an open mind and enjoy the new start.

exercises.title: U1 听力·短文 A Good Beginning
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: People often say that a good beginning is half the success.
Starting senior high may feel hard at the very first.
You meet new teachers and face many new challenges.
But if you stay calm and try your best, things get easier.
Remember to help your friends, and you will feel good too.
exercises.translation_cn: 人们常说,良好的开端是成功的一半;刚上高中可能会觉得艰难;你要遇见新老师,面对许多新挑战;但只要保持镇定、尽力而为,事情就会变得容易;别忘了帮助朋友,你自己也会感觉很好。

questions.stem: What do people often say about a good beginning?
options: It is a waste of time.

questions.stem: How may starting senior high feel at first?

What helps things get easier?
options: Staying calm and trying your best.
